extends: economics/model.json (2026-08-03 specification); retains source value, client value, SISO price/profit and societal value as separate concepts
unit: repository × bounded process × customer archetype × adoption route × observed comparison period
missing_data_policy: Any unknown mandatory input produces null, not zero, a planning default or an invented range. A zero is permitted only as an explicit measured value with a receipt. Numeric synthetic fixtures test the formula only and are never market estimates.

formulas.annual_capacity_hours: annual_units * (baseline_human_minutes_per_unit - assisted_human_minutes_per_unit) / 60; assisted time includes review, rework and exception handling
formulas.first_year_net_cash: verified_cancelled_software_spend + verified_realized_labor_cash_savings + verified_incremental_contribution_margin + verified_risk_loss_reduction - annual_operating_cost - first_year_change_cost
formulas.capacity_shadow_value: annual_capacity_hours * measured_loaded_hourly_cost; report as non-cash capacity equivalent, never add to first_year_net_cash without observed monetization
formulas.societal_resource_value: eligible_businesses * observed_adoption_fraction * measured_net_real_resource_benefit_per_business - measured_transition_externalities; not aggregate software revenue, willingness to pay, firm count × repo stars, or gross billable hours
formulas.evidence_score: count of verified items among seven named receipt gates; display numerator/denominator. This is evidence completeness, NOT a valuation or quality multiplier.

guardrails: Cancelled spend means actually removable spend, not a competitor's list price.
Released employee time is capacity unless reduced payroll/overtime or redeployment value is observed.
Saved billable hours can reduce revenue; do not presume higher profit.
Use contribution margin, not gross revenue; do not double-count the same benefit across modules.
Keep negative net results; a negative result is a valid rejection, not clipped to zero.
Source/edition rights and critical quality/security failures are hard adoption gates, not discount multipliers.
Do not extrapolate a sampled firm to an industry or society without measured eligible population, adoption and externalities.
falsifiers: Net human time including review/rework is not lower than baseline: reject the productivity claim.
Actual cancellable spend is zero or contract cannot be terminated: reject the displacement term.
The same benefit ID is allocated in full to multiple modules: reject the aggregate.
An observed first-year net cash result is non-positive: reject a cash-saving offer unless a different explicitly authorized goal is documented.
Critical data/authority error occurs or baseline quality is not preserved: no adoption regardless of monetary result.
An outcome falls outside a preregistered predicted interval: forecast calibration fails and requires revision.
forecast_policy: No business prediction interval is generated in this pass; required baseline/field inputs are absent. Later low/base/high estimates must cite evidence and preregister a comparison period, not reuse the older illustrative priors.
